<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { toast } from 'vue-sonner'

const email = ref('')
const loading = ref(false)

async function submit() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 450))
    toast.success('Invite sent')
    email.value = ''
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <form class="flex gap-2" @submit.prevent="submit">
    <Input v-model="email" type="email" placeholder="name@company.com" autocomplete="email" />
    <Button :disabled="loading || !email" type="submit">Invite</Button>
  </form>
</template>
quality_feedback: Looks good. Added type=email and autocomplete. Consider adding aria-label on Input if used without visible label.

a11y.message: Input has no associated visible label; add <Label> or aria-label.

a11y.message: Native input is ok, but consider using UI Input for consistent focus styles.

best_practices.message: Lowercasing is good; consider trimming duplicates by slugging spaces.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'

const apiKey = ref('sk_live_************************')
const copied = ref(false)

async function copy() {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(apiKey.value)
  copied.value = true
  window.setTimeout(() => (copied.value = false), 1500)
}
</script>

<template>
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>API key</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>Use this key with the billing service.</CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent>
      <Input :model-value="apiKey" readonly aria-label="API key" />
    </CardContent>
    <CardFooter class="justify-end">
      <Button variant="secondary" type="button" @click="copy">{{ copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy' }}</Button>
    </CardFooter>
  </Card>
</template>
quality_feedback: Clipboard usage OK. Consider guarding for insecure contexts and providing fallback if navigator.clipboard is unavailable.

best_practices.message: navigator.clipboard may fail on http or blocked contexts; add try/catch and fallback.

quality_feedback: Select wiring is correct. Nice aria-label. Consider formatting price as currency and using number type for price display.

best_practices.message: Format price with Intl.NumberFormat for locale-friendly currency.
